summary: Frontend-only validation of APK splash-freeze fix completed. Verified in code that splash hide is now tied to root onLayout when appReady, with a 3-second fallback and safe duplicate hide handling. Expo web preview loads onboarding (no blank/splash freeze), and no blocking runtime errors were observed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking and unrelated to splash fix.

action_items: Build and validate release APK on Android device/emulator to fully confirm cold-start splash behavior in native release context.
Optional cleanup: address RNW pointerEvents deprecation warning source.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: _layout.tsx computes appReady from loaded || error || startupTimedOut, preventing startup deadlock.
PASS: Splash hide is centralized in hideSplash() with catch(), making duplicate/unsupported hide calls safe.
PASS: Root onLayout handler only hides splash when appReady=true, aligning hide timing with first layout/frame.
PASS: 3-second fallback timeout sets startupTimedOut and calls hideSplash; timeout cleanup is implemented in useEffect return.
PASS: Render guard returns null until appReady, preventing premature tree render before readiness criteria.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview confirms onboarding render and no splash freeze regression after _layout.tsx startup guard change. Native release APK behavior still requires device-level validation.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (from PRD): in release APK, icon font map resolves immediately causing prior hideAsync timing before first Android layout/frame. Mitigation now implemented by gating hide via root onLayout with a 3s fallback and duplicate-hide-safe catch.
